ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary File Download Via IMEWDBLD.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of "IMEWDBLD.exe" to download arbitrary files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\IMEWDBLD\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "imewdbld\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*")))
